# SoundPrint

> > SoundPrint is a noise-rating app and database that helps users find quiet venues by crowdsourcing sound level measurements and providing acoustic guidance for hearing health.

SoundPrint combines mobile technology with community science to measure and share noise levels in restaurants, cafes, and public spaces. The platform empowers users to discover quieter venues while helping venue managers improve acoustic environments through data-driven insights.

## Key Topics

- Sound measurement
- Hearing health
- Noise levels
- SoundCheck (measurement tool)
- Decibel levels (dBA)
- Quiet venues
- Venue finder
- Noise pollution
- Hearing safety

## Getting Started

- [SoundPrint - Find Your Quiet Place](https://www.soundprint.co): Homepage for SoundPrint noise-rating app for discovering quiet venues
- [Download the SoundPrint App](https://www.soundprint.co/download): App download page for SoundPrint decibel measurement application
- [How The App Works](https://www.soundprint.co/how-to-use-app): Tutorial on using SoundPrint app features and SoundCheck measurement

## Discover Quiet Venues

- [Quiet Lists](https://www.soundprint.co/quiet-lists): Curated city guides listing quietest venues by noise level measurements
- [Pearl Hour / Monterey, CA](https://www.soundprint.co/location/pearl-hour-monterey-ca-7252504): Venue profile for Pearl Hour in Monterey with crowdsourced noise data
- [Due South / Albany, WA](https://www.soundprint.co/location/due-south-albany-wa-8151333): Venue profile for Due South restaurant in Albany with sound measurements
- [Trencher's Kitchen & Tap / Renton, WA](https://www.soundprint.co/location/trencher-s-kitchen-tap-renton-wa-6711394): Venue profile for gastropub in Renton with noise level ratings
- [Viet Family - The Vegan House / Vancouver, BC](https://www.soundprint.co/location/viet-family-the-vegan-house-vancouver-bc-5845226): Venue profile for vegan restaurant in Vancouver with decibel measurements
